{{Top|leg}}
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] possessed a massive '''fleet''' of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that included [[Owool Interceptor]]s. The Wookiee [[Rock Council]] met at [[Council Rock]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] to discuss whether they should lend their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in its [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] against the breakaway [[Confederation]]. The Galactic Alliance's [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]] arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and its tyrannical [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] accused the Wookiees of harboring [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitives. When they denied the accusation, the Fifth Fleet began to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to let them know that Solo did not approve of them dragging their toes. The Wookiee fleet fought back in the ensuing [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|battle]] and were joined by several other Confederate fleets. The Galactic Alliance fled, and the Wookiees joined an informal [[Jedi Coalition]].
